resource_cost.host_cpu_scope: Whole host average across cores for final monitoring interval; includes asynchronous kernel/network and controller overhead. Excludes idle, iowait, steal and duplicate guest.
resource_cost.policy_calls_source: Initial action plus valid feedback actions; no exploration or implicit fallback

config.source: Deterministic integer1ms service; independent event sequences, not phase rotation
config.quantization: integer1ms, no invented tail packets; no wrap during900s run
config.queue_rule: Only queue depth varied; same trace/hash/baseRTT/policy/noise0
config.model_source: Native CUBIC; no model loaded

cfg.source: Deterministic integer1ms service; independent event sequences, not phase rotation
cfg.quantization: integer1ms, no invented tail packets; no wrap during900s run
cfg.queue_rule: Only queue depth varied; same trace/hash/baseRTT/policy/noise0
cfg.model_source: Native CUBIC; no model loaded
cfg.feedback_completion_rule: At least 5 valid feedback samples, unchanged 15s watchdog and fixed wall-clock duration; a low ACK-limited sample rate is measured performance rather than automatically a process failure
